correctness.rationale: The real Hermitian lift of eight intensities at z_j=(1+i)^j has rank 8, exact deleted-ninth-column minor -19660800000, kernel coordinates (256,-150,2,-48,-96,3,3,-9,3), and kernel Hermitian determinant -111540. I independently built the exact SymPy lift and checked rank, minor, kernel and determinant. Any difference of rank-one coefficient Gram matrices has rank <=2 and therefore cannot occupy this rank-three kernel line. For <=7 evaluations, if evaluation vectors span C^3 then the real Hermitian kernel dimension >=2; the odd real determinant on an independent kernel circle vanishes, and a nonzero singular kernel matrix cannot be semidefinite (spanning), yielding a rank-two indefinite counterexample. The analytic determinant witness is nonzero at (0,...,7), so its nonvanishing is open dense in every real parameter cube, giving eight good samples on every subarc. Includes p=0 and lower degrees. No conditioning theorem is claimed.
